subject: POC onboarding: success metrics, timeline & SSO/API access
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluewave.com>, Jules Park <jules.park@bluewave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: POC onboarding: success metrics, timeline & SSO/API access

Hi Alex / Jules —

Thanks again for the productive demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track the POC scope and access items. I copied Karthik and Laura for handoffs.

High-level POC goal
- Validate Redwood Inference for product search re-ranking on BlueWave pilot dataset (50k queries, 7M tokens).

Success criteria (agreed on call)
1) 15-20% improvement in click-through rate on the top-10 re-rank compared to current baseline.
2) Average inference latency under 120ms p50 for 512-token requests during a 5qps sustained window.
3) Cost estimate <= $0.0025/token (to be measured on the test slice).

Evaluation plan and timeline
- 06/25: POC kickoff call (technical and security).
- 06/25–07/03: Ingestion + test runs on a private test dataset.
- 07/06: Internal review of metrics; decide expansion/rollout.

Owners
- Redwood AE: Karthik Iyer (overall POC coordination).
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Laura Bennett (integration, embeddings & config).
- BlueWave POC Lead: Alex Kim (dataset, acceptance criteria signoff).

Access & provisioning (needs from BlueWave)
1) SSO: preferred for team access. Please send IDP metadata (SAML metadata XML) or add redwood@redwood.com as an SP contact so we can send the SSO invite. If you prefer email invites instead, send the list of teammates + emails.
2) API key for trial: We can issue a provisional key scoped to the trial environment. Let us know which API key name you want (e.g., bluewave-poc-1).
3) IP allowlist: If your env requires IP allowlisting, we will provide our egress ranges. Please confirm any specific ranges you need us to add.

Attachments: I attached the POC evaluation template and a short security checklist to speed reviews.

Can you confirm the SSO approach (SAML exchange vs email invites) and the preferred owner for provisioning? Once we have that we will create the POC ticket and issue the provisional credentials.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachment: poc-eval-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluewave.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jules Park <jules.park@bluewave.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: success metrics, timeline & SSO/API access

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the clear recap. We’re aligned on the success criteria and timeline. A few details from our side:

POC dataset
- We will provide a sampled dataset (50k queries, anonymized) by EOD 06/22. Point of contact for dataset: Jules Park (jules.park@bluewave.com).

SSO / IdP
- We prefer SSO. Our IdP team uses Okta. I’ve copied Jules (IdP contact) — he can either share SAML metadata XML or accept an SP metadata from you. Okta domain: bluewave.okta.com.

IP allowlist
- Our security team prefers IP allowlist for test endpoints. Current ranges to add on your side: 52.23.128.0/24, 18.204.0.0/16. If you need us to add anything else, tell us and we’ll route to infra.

API key
- Please provision a provisional key named: bluewave-poc-2026. We’ll use that for test runs and rotate after the POC.

Docs / approvals
- Our security team needs the checklist and a short note on data retention (we’ll review your attached PDF). They aim to complete review by 06/30.

Thanks — we can take the 06/25 kickoff at 10:00 AM ET if that works for your team.

Alex — great, Okta is straightforward. Quick follow-up with the internal assignments and provisioning plan: 

Action items assigned
- Karthik: create the HubSpot deal & kickoff invite, coordinate commercial terms and DocuSign if needed. (karthik.iyer@redwood.com)
- Laura: lead technical kickoff, pre-provision embeddings pipeline and run an initial smoke test once API key is live. (laura.bennett@redwood.com)
- Sofia: coordinate access + security paperwork; issue provisional API key.

Provisioning plan (what we’ll do immediately)
1) We will set up a provisional API key named "bluewave-poc-2026" scoped to the POC environment and rate-limited to the agreed window.
2) We will provide our egress IP ranges for your allowlist: 52.9.0.0/18, 34.200.128.0/17. If you prefer us to use the ranges you listed instead, we can accommodate.
3) Laura will reach out with a short integration checklist before the kickoff.

I’ve attached a short runbook (initial-poc-mop.md) that outlines the onboarding steps we’ll follow on 06/25.

Provisional credentials (please treat as placeholder — we will rotate keys at the end of the POC)
- API key name: bluewave-poc-2026
- API key (provisional): rk_test_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX

If Okta needs an SP metadata file from us, Laura will follow up early this week with the SAML metadata and ACS/Entity IDs.

Linking the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4891 — Karthik will keep this up to date.

If everything above looks good, I’ll schedule the 06/25 10:00 AM ET kickoff and kick off the provisioning.

—
Sofia Ivanova
